exposure.needed: whether users or scripts run the Hubble CLI with the --cluster flag and rely on it only showing flows emitted from nodes in that cluster

consequence.statement: Hubble CLI `--cluster foo` now also shows flows emitted from nodes outside cluster `foo` (flows coming from or going to the target cluster), not only flows emitted from nodes in cluster `foo`.
consequence.remediation: To reproduce the previous behavior of `--cluster foo`, use `--node-name foo/` (shows all flows emitted from a node in cluster `foo`).

assertion.statement: In Cilium 1.17 the Hubble CLI `--cluster` flag also shows flows emitted from nodes outside the named cluster when they come from or go to that cluster; to get the old behavior, use `--node-name foo/`.
